_comment: Gzip limits (level 9) for the production build, enforced by scripts/check-budgets.mjs. Measured 22 Nov 2026 on one laptop for the voice-first rebuild (see docs/performance.md): first-load JS 109.3 kB, first-load CSS 7.2 kB, largest lazy chunk 30.3 kB (Call), largest CSS file 5.8 kB, no fonts. The first-load JS limit is the product target (110 kB), not measured plus headroom, so that moving a barrel, the voice catalogue or a chart library into the entry chunk cannot go unnoticed; the other limits leave modest headroom. Fonts, source maps, extra pages and zod are not budgeted: they are not allowed at all. Raising a limit is a decision: say why in the commit.
